545    public function testStringLiteralMaskPreservesOffsetsAndQuotedIdentifiers(): void
546    {
547        $parser = new SqliteParser();
548        $sql = "SELECT 'FROM hidden', \"quoted\", `backtick`, [bracket] FROM items";
549        $masked = $parser->maskStringLiterals($sql);
550        self::assertSame(strlen($sql), strlen($masked));
551        self::assertSame(strpos($sql, 'FROM items'), strpos($masked, 'FROM items'));
552        self::assertStringContainsString('"quoted"', $masked);
553        self::assertStringContainsString('`backtick`', $masked);
554        self::assertStringContainsString('[bracket]', $masked);
555    }
556
557    #[DataProvider('providerStringLiteralMasks')]
558    public function testMaskStringLiteralsUsesSqliteQuoteBoundaries(string $sql, string $expected): void
559    {
560        $parser = new SqliteParser();
561        $masked = $parser->maskStringLiterals($sql);
562        self::assertSame($expected, $masked);
563        self::assertSame(strlen($sql), strlen($masked));
564    }
565
566    /**
567     * @return \Generator<string, array{string, string}>
568     */
569    public static function providerStringLiteralMasks(): \Generator
570    {
571        yield 'empty query' => ['', ''];
572        yield 'query without strings' => ['SELECT value FROM items', 'SELECT value FROM items'];
573        yield 'empty string' => ["''", '  '];
574        yield 'single quoted string' => ["SELECT 'FROM hidden' FROM items", 'SELECT ' . str_repeat(' ', 13) . ' FROM items'];
575        yield 'doubled single quote' => ["'value''FROM' FROM items", str_repeat(' ', 13) . ' FROM items'];
576        yield 'doubled quote before closing quote' => ["'a''' FROM items", str_repeat(' ', 5) . ' FROM items'];
577        yield 'unterminated string' => ["'FROM hidden", str_repeat(' ', 12)];
578        yield 'multiple strings' => ["'FROM' || 'JOIN' FROM items", str_repeat(' ', 6) . ' || ' . str_repeat(' ', 6) . ' FROM items'];
579        yield 'newline in string' => ["'FROM\nJOIN' FROM items", str_repeat(' ', 11) . ' FROM items'];
580        yield 'double quoted identifier' => ['"FROM" FROM items', '"FROM" FROM items'];
581        yield 'backtick identifier' => ['`FROM` FROM items', '`FROM` FROM items'];
582        yield 'bracket identifier' => ['[FROM] FROM items', '[FROM] FROM items'];
583        yield 'backslash does not escape quote' => ["'closed \\' FROM items", str_repeat(' ', 10) . ' FROM items'];
584    }

657        $sql = '/* lead */WITH/* separator */[select] ([select])/* separator */AS/* separator */(VALUES ("select"))/* separator */REPLACE/* separator */INTO/* separator */`select` DEFAULT/* separator */VALUES';
658        self::assertSame('INSERT', $parser->classifyStatement($sql));
659    }

675    #[DataProvider('providerLexicalClassificationBoundaries')]
676    public function testClassifyStatementUsesLexicalBoundaries(string $sql, ?string $expected): void
677    {
678        $parser = new SqliteParser();
679        self::assertSame($expected, $parser->classifyStatement($sql));
680    }
681
682    /**
683     * @return \Generator<string, array{string, ?string}>
684     */
685    public static function providerLexicalClassificationBoundaries(): \Generator
686    {
687        yield 'with requires completed group' => ['WITH SELECT', null];
688        yield 'line comment with newline' => ["-- SELECT\nUPDATE name SET value = 1", 'UPDATE'];
689        yield 'line comment with carriage return' => ["-- SELECT\rDELETE FROM name", 'DELETE'];
690        yield 'hash comment' => ["# SELECT\nINSERT INTO name DEFAULT VALUES", 'INSERT'];
691        yield 'line comment at end' => ['-- SELECT', null];
692        yield 'minimal block comment' => ['/**/SELECT 1', 'SELECT'];
693        yield 'overlapping block delimiter is unterminated' => ['/*/SELECT 1', null];
694        yield 'block comment closing boundary' => ['/**/*SELECT 1', 'SELECT'];
695        yield 'unterminated block comment' => ['/* SELECT */ UPDATE /* SELECT', 'UPDATE'];
696        yield 'double quoted keyword' => ['"SELECT" UPDATE name SET value = 1', 'UPDATE'];
697        yield 'backtick quoted keyword' => ['`SELECT` DELETE FROM name', 'DELETE'];
698        yield 'empty single quoted string' => ["''SELECT 1", 'SELECT'];
699        yield 'empty double quoted identifier' => ['""SELECT 1', 'SELECT'];
700        yield 'doubled single quote' => ["'value''SELECT' UPDATE name SET value = 1", 'UPDATE'];
701        yield 'doubled double quote' => ['"value""SELECT" DELETE FROM name', 'DELETE'];
702        yield 'doubled backtick' => ['`value``SELECT` INSERT INTO name DEFAULT VALUES', 'INSERT'];
703        yield 'unterminated single quote' => ["'SELECT UPDATE", null];
704        yield 'unterminated double quote' => ['"SELECT UPDATE', null];
705        yield 'empty bracket identifier' => ['[]SELECT 1', 'SELECT'];
706        yield 'bracket quoted keyword' => ['[SELECT] UPDATE name SET value = 1', 'UPDATE'];
707        yield 'unterminated bracket identifier' => ['[SELECT UPDATE', null];
708        yield 'underscore identifier' => ['_SELECT UPDATE name SET value = 1', 'UPDATE'];
709        yield 'dollar identifier' => ['$SELECT DELETE FROM name', 'DELETE'];
710        yield 'numeric identifier' => ['1SELECT INSERT INTO name DEFAULT VALUES', 'INSERT'];
711        yield 'parenthesized keyword' => ['(SELECT) UPDATE name SET value = 1', 'UPDATE'];
712        yield 'nested parenthesized keyword' => ['((SELECT)) DELETE FROM name', 'DELETE'];
713        yield 'temporary non-table create' => ['CREATE TEMPORARY INDEX name', null];
714    }

2965    public function testInsertValuesSourceIgnoresQuotedKeywordIdentifiers(): void
2966    {
2967        $parser = new SqliteParser();
2968        $tableSelect = "INSERT INTO \"select\" (id, val) VALUES (1, 'table-select')";
2969        $tableValues = "INSERT INTO \"values\" (id, val) VALUES (2, 'table-values')";
2970        $columnKeywords = "INSERT INTO test (id, \"select\", \"values\") VALUES (3, 'column-select', 'column-values')";
2971
2972        self::assertFalse($parser->hasInsertSelect($tableSelect));
2973        self::assertNull($parser->extractInsertSelect($tableSelect));
2974        self::assertSame([['1', "'table-select'"]], $parser->extractInsertValues($tableSelect));
2975        self::assertFalse($parser->hasInsertSelect($tableValues));
2976        self::assertNull($parser->extractInsertSelect($tableValues));
2977        self::assertSame([['2', "'table-values'"]], $parser->extractInsertValues($tableValues));
2978        self::assertFalse($parser->hasInsertSelect($columnKeywords));
2979        self::assertNull($parser->extractInsertSelect($columnKeywords));
2980        self::assertSame([['3', "'column-select'", "'column-values'"]], $parser->extractInsertValues($columnKeywords));
2981    }

573    #[DataProvider('providerStringLiteralMasks')]
574    public function testMaskStringLiteralsUsesSqliteQuoteBoundaries(string $sql, string $expected): void
575    {
576        $parser = new SqliteParser();

582    /**
583     * @return Generator<string, array{string, string}>
584     */
585    public static function providerStringLiteralMasks(): Generator
586    {
587        yield 'empty query' => ['', ''];
588        yield 'query without strings' => ['SELECT value FROM items', 'SELECT value FROM items'];
589        yield 'empty string' => ["''", '  '];
590        yield 'single quoted string' => ["SELECT 'FROM hidden' FROM items", 'SELECT ' . str_repeat(' ', 13) . ' FROM items'];
591        yield 'doubled single quote' => ["'value''FROM' FROM items", str_repeat(' ', 13) . ' FROM items'];
592        yield 'doubled quote before closing quote' => ["'a''' FROM items", str_repeat(' ', 5) . ' FROM items'];
593        yield 'unterminated string' => ["'FROM hidden", str_repeat(' ', 12)];
594        yield 'multiple strings' => ["'FROM' || 'JOIN' FROM items", str_repeat(' ', 6) . ' || ' . str_repeat(' ', 6) . ' FROM items'];
595        yield 'newline in string' => ["'FROM\nJOIN' FROM items", str_repeat(' ', 11) . ' FROM items'];
596        yield 'double quoted identifier' => ['"FROM" FROM items', '"FROM" FROM items'];
597        yield 'backtick identifier' => ['`FROM` FROM items', '`FROM` FROM items'];
598        yield 'bracket identifier' => ['[FROM] FROM items', '[FROM] FROM items'];
599        yield 'backslash does not escape quote' => ["'closed \\' FROM items", str_repeat(' ', 10) . ' FROM items'];
600    }

692    public function testClassifyStatementUsesLexicalBoundaries(string $sql, ?string $expected): void

698    /**
699     * @return Generator<string, array{string, ?string}>
700     */
701    public static function providerLexicalClassificationBoundaries(): Generator
702    {
703        yield 'with requires completed group' => ['WITH SELECT', null];
704        yield 'line comment with newline' => ["-- SELECT\nUPDATE name SET value = 1", 'UPDATE'];
705        yield 'line comment with carriage return' => ["-- SELECT\rDELETE FROM name", 'DELETE'];
706        yield 'hash comment' => ["# SELECT\nINSERT INTO name DEFAULT VALUES", 'INSERT'];
707        yield 'line comment at end' => ['-- SELECT', null];
708        yield 'minimal block comment' => ['/**/SELECT 1', 'SELECT'];
709        yield 'overlapping block delimiter is unterminated' => ['/*/SELECT 1', null];
710        yield 'block comment closing boundary' => ['/**/*SELECT 1', 'SELECT'];
711        yield 'unterminated block comment' => ['/* SELECT */ UPDATE /* SELECT', 'UPDATE'];
712        yield 'double quoted keyword' => ['"SELECT" UPDATE name SET value = 1', 'UPDATE'];
713        yield 'backtick quoted keyword' => ['`SELECT` DELETE FROM name', 'DELETE'];
714        yield 'empty single quoted string' => ["''SELECT 1", 'SELECT'];
715        yield 'empty double quoted identifier' => ['""SELECT 1', 'SELECT'];
716        yield 'doubled single quote' => ["'value''SELECT' UPDATE name SET value = 1", 'UPDATE'];
717        yield 'doubled double quote' => ['"value""SELECT" DELETE FROM name', 'DELETE'];
718        yield 'doubled backtick' => ['`value``SELECT` INSERT INTO name DEFAULT VALUES', 'INSERT'];
719        yield 'unterminated single quote' => ["'SELECT UPDATE", null];
720        yield 'unterminated double quote' => ['"SELECT UPDATE', null];
721        yield 'empty bracket identifier' => ['[]SELECT 1', 'SELECT'];
722        yield 'bracket quoted keyword' => ['[SELECT] UPDATE name SET value = 1', 'UPDATE'];
723        yield 'unterminated bracket identifier' => ['[SELECT UPDATE', null];
724        yield 'underscore identifier' => ['_SELECT UPDATE name SET value = 1', 'UPDATE'];
725        yield 'dollar identifier' => ['$SELECT DELETE FROM name', 'DELETE'];
726        yield 'numeric identifier' => ['1SELECT INSERT INTO name DEFAULT VALUES', 'INSERT'];
727        yield 'parenthesized keyword' => ['(SELECT) UPDATE name SET value = 1', 'UPDATE'];
728        yield 'nested parenthesized keyword' => ['((SELECT)) DELETE FROM name', 'DELETE'];
729        yield 'temporary non-table create' => ['CREATE TEMPORARY INDEX name', null];
730    }

2981    public function testInsertValuesSourceIgnoresQuotedKeywordIdentifiers(): void
2982    {
2983        $parser = new SqliteParser();
2984        $tableSelect = "INSERT INTO \"select\" (id, val) VALUES (1, 'table-select')";
2985        $tableValues = "INSERT INTO \"values\" (id, val) VALUES (2, 'table-values')";
2986        $columnKeywords = "INSERT INTO test (id, \"select\", \"values\") VALUES (3, 'column-select', 'column-values')";
2987
2988        self::assertFalse($parser->hasInsertSelect($tableSelect));
2989        self::assertNull($parser->extractInsertSelect($tableSelect));
2990        self::assertSame([['1', "'table-select'"]], $parser->extractInsertValues($tableSelect));
2991        self::assertFalse($parser->hasInsertSelect($tableValues));
2992        self::assertNull($parser->extractInsertSelect($tableValues));
2993        self::assertSame([['2', "'table-values'"]], $parser->extractInsertValues($tableValues));
2994        self::assertFalse($parser->hasInsertSelect($columnKeywords));
2995        self::assertNull($parser->extractInsertSelect($columnKeywords));
2996        self::assertSame([['3', "'column-select'", "'column-values'"]], $parser->extractInsertValues($columnKeywords));
2997    }

3041

3045        ], $parser->extractUpdateAssignments($sql));
3046        self::assertSame('products.category_id = c.id', $parser->extractWhereClause($sql));

3048        self::assertSame('1', $parser->extractLimitClause($sql));
